description.value:
Frequency once per day

Cost 5 Encore

Prerequisites access to The Gap

Traits Signal

You spend 5 Encore and apply The Gap to every enemy in range at once, resolving it separately against each. Your Broadcast then ends, and you cannot begin another for 1 hour. Nothing that depends on broadcasting works during that hour: no Encore is gained, no Frequency applies, and no ally can spend Encore, because there is no pool.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB1 (cost) stacked on SB4 (The Gap) and SB3 (ends/locks out Broadcast). No SpecialResource rule element exists for Encore, this class's own resource (defined only in prose in classes.the-signal.json's terms flag). SpecialResource can model a permanent resource pool (renew: false) per pf2e-source, so this is a real gap, not a schema limitation, but nothing in the corpus fills it -- no companion class-feature/ability/effect card holds it either. No "Broadcast" stance/aura item is ever instantiated as an Item with its own system.rules anywhere in this corpus. The shape (a stance whose aura buffs allies) is real and buildable in pf2e via Aura + a companion effect item -- but no such Broadcast item exists among this class's files to attach a rule element to. All three Frequency-track base auras (Numbers, Open Band, Requiem, and their action-card twins) ship "rules": [] despite describing at-will auras with real numbers. Buildable in principle via Aura + a companion effect (same shape as SB3), unbuildable in practice because no such companion item exists, and because the base aura's own radius/uptime is itself gated on the un-encoded Broadcast (SB3).
